intro.text: A former member of the King's Guard of Alethkar, serving under Kaladin.

items.text: When Bridge Four took over guarding King Elhokar, many of the King's Guard, Taka among them, stayed on under Kaladin. Taka was on duty with Moash the night Elhokar visited Kaladin's barracks; he stood close to the king while Moash watched the door, and left with Moash when Elhokar asked to speak to Kaladin alone.
